*It was a warm spring day. Birds were chirping, the trees were in bloom and a number of Reine’s neighbors were out on the nearby lake fishing in the calm blue water.*

*Ordinarily, on a day like this, Reine would be sitting on her porch, reading a book and enjoying the sunlight and the breeze. Unfortunately, there was some kind of leak in the ceiling in her old Victorian house, and it needed to be fixed before she could get any peace of mind.*

*So Reine sat on the couch in her living room, twiddling her thumbs and waiting for the repairman. She had called a different one this time from the next town over, since all the local repairmen were busy. Hopefully this one knew his stuff.*

*At the ring of the doorbell, Reine sprung up and threw her shawl over her shoulders before walking over to the door and opening it.*

“Hi!” *she said to the guy on the other side* “I’m Reine. I believe we spoke on the phone?”
